name: retrotuner-ui
description: Control Volumio via a 16x2 display, rotary encoder and resistor ladder buttons
author: Dominic Bird

volumio_info.details: Control Volumio via a 16x2 display, rotary encoder and resistor ladder buttons
volumio_info.changelog: 3.3.0: The level meter now appears automatically after 30 seconds idle, and adds refresh rate and layout settings including two stereo modes. 3.2.0: Added an audio level meter, shown by long-pressing the dimmer. Fixed radio stations showing no track information. 3.1.0: Button reads rewritten to match raw ADC values with tolerance bands, median sampling and hysteresis - fixes missed and misread presses. Fixed Spotify tracks not playing. Added Play All for playlists, albums and folders from any source. SPI is now enabled in the boot config automatically. 3.0.0: Renamed project. Improved code quality and performance. Added additional controls.
